verdict.rationale: Unstructured's pricing page says it can be deployed in your own dedicated instance or VPC with full data isolation, and its dedicated-instance security docs describe private connectivity (PrivateLink) and IP allowlisting. A community commenter independently reports that self-hosting the official Unstructured Docker image was hassle-free. Missing for 10: first-party step-by-step VPC/self-hosted deployment documentation (the VPC offering is sales-gated with tailored pricing), first-party documentation of the fully self-hosted Docker path, and clarity on whether self-hosted builds match the hosted platform's features.
